_what: RUN HEAD -> experiments/ TREE ID -> ORIGIN TWIN for today's ladder cells. This CLOSES a provenance gap: every H100 cell today logged a run HEAD that NEVER REACHED ORIGIN, so the tree a committed cell ran on could not be reconstructed by anyone else. It is closed not by recovering the commits but by TREE IDENTITY, which is stronger: each run's experiments/ tree is byte-identical to a tree on origin/main.
_the_cause_found_by_the_H100: its driver commits each cell LOCALLY and records HEAD, then the push path runs `git pull --rebase`, which REWRITES those local commits. The recorded sha therefore never reaches origin and survives only as a pre-rebase object in that one clone. THIS APPLIES TO EVERY H100 CELL LOGGED TODAY, not only the ladder.
_how_this_table_was_VERIFIED_by_flash: the H100's own run HEADs DO NOT RESOLVE in any other clone and are not fetchable, so they cannot be checked off-box. What CAN be checked, and was: for each claimed experiments/ tree id, `git rev-parse <origin-twin>:experiments` was run HERE against origin/main. ALL SIX MATCHED THE FULL 40-CHARACTER TREE ID. So the table is OBSERVED by flash on the origin side, and the run-HEAD column alone is REPORTED by the H100.
